summary: Noninteractive JSON CLI over authenticated public operations, with optional connection flags loaded through whab-cli CONFIG ...

operations.name: interface
operations.summary: Provide the declared cli interface or remote authority adapter.

output.description: The operation result in the enclosing response data field.

operations.side_effects: The interface delegates explicit reads/mutations to public services; it does not define financial rules.
operations.permissions: Host-scoped SDK access; this callback is not remotely callable.
operations.scope: Host-supplied budget/environment context and personal/demo workspace where the method accepts it. Credentials remain machine-local.
errors: Invalid or unsupported input is rejected without applying a new decision.
Unavailable feature/storage returns an authored error; stale revisions and reused request IDs with different intent conflict.
operations.retry: Read again as needed; reads never authorize a later write using an old revision.
operations.availability: SDK callback only; consult the owning README for the typed in-process contract.

operations.name: status

output.description: Action-specific local response; secrets are never returned.

operations.permissions: Local authority access with HTTPS and Host/origin checks. Not exposed by the remote ledger API.
operations.scope: Explicit budget and personal/demo workspace; currencies are never combined.
errors: Invalid or unsupported input is rejected without applying a new decision.
Unavailable feature/storage returns an authored error; stale revisions and reused request IDs with different intent conflict.
operations.retry: Inspect local state after an uncertain mutation. Paid inference is never automatically retried.
